中心简介
ABOUT THE CENTER

西北地区唯一的
国家级超算中心

Northwest China's Only National
Supercomputing Center

国家超级计算西安中心于2021年经科学技术部批准筹建，2023年正式纳入国家超级计算中心序列， 成为全国第13个、西北地区唯一的国家级超算中心。

Approved for development by the Ministry of Science and Technology in 2021, the Center joined China's national supercomputing network in 2023. It is the country's 13th national supercomputing center and the only one in Northwest China.

重点面向先进制造、航空航天、生物医药、地球物理、新材料、新能源、人工智能、集成电路等关键领域， 支撑交叉科学研究、核心技术攻关与产业转型升级。

We provide advanced computing infrastructure for manufacturing, aerospace, biomedicine, geophysics, new materials, new energy, artificial intelligence, and integrated circuits.

核心能力
CORE CAPABILITIES

六大核心能力，构建智能计算新生态

Six Capabilities. One Intelligent Computing Ecosystem.

采用国产自主可控的处理器及异构加速卡，配备绿色节能的浸没式相变液冷技术， 已通过国家网络安全等级保护三级认证。

A secure, energy-efficient infrastructure built on domestically developed processors, heterogeneous accelerators, and immersion phase-change liquid cooling.

高性能计算 HIGH-PERFORMANCE COMPUTING

计算系统

Computing System

国产自主可控 CPU 集群，万卡级人工智能加速平台，支持科学计算、工程计算、智能计算与通用计算。

A domestically developed CPU cluster and AI platform with more than 10,000 accelerator cards for scientific, engineering, AI, and general-purpose workloads.

EB 级扩展 EB-SCALE

存储系统

Storage System

EB 级高性能并行存储架构，多协议、多介质融合存储体系，支持 EB 级扩展能力。

An exabyte-scale parallel storage architecture unifying multiple protocols and storage media, with seamless capacity expansion.

高带宽、低延时内部网络，多骨干、高可靠外部接入网络，多运营商骨干接入。

A high-bandwidth, low-latency fabric with resilient external connectivity across multiple carrier backbones.
